content: Since data of different tasks have different noise patterns, the probability of overfitting to noise is reduced with samples from different tasks. This can also be visualized as decision boundaries of models trained on various dataset combinations. For Fig. SECREF2 , we embed the 480-dimensional feature vector into 2 dimensions using Locally Linear Embeddings BIBREF16 trained on DB.
